title: The Metaphor Stretch
idiom: Kandinsky-like gouache, a string stretched from an orrery to a player's hand
hero_prompt: Gouache painting in the manner of Kandinsky's 1920s work, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a single taut string stretched across a wide chasm between two cliffs; on the left cliff a brass orrery of planets on rings, on the right cliff a woman musician plucking the string, which bows into one graceful curve over the gap. Flat circles, arcs and triangles, yellow, red, blue and black on cream.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a yellow ground, no shading or gradients: two cliff edges facing each other across a gap, joined by one taut string that bows into a single curve, a small hand plucking it at the right. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
